note: DAN.1.11-16, the ten-day test. The terraced garden, north-east of the precinct: a stepped, planted structure whose lower ground (south of the terrace) hosts the vegetable-and-water test, and whose upper ground (north of the terrace) hosts the rich table the four refuse. Using the garden rather than the food pavilion keeps this scene visually distinct from scene 5's food pavilion, the other eating beat. Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah cluster loosely on the lower terrace with the attendant he persuaded and the cook who plates their vegetables; the trainee at the rich table sits alone on the upper terrace, eating the king's fare, so the two diets read as two separate groups rather than one crowd. Three guides (the joint-most of any scene) are spread across both terraces, kept apart from the cast so they stay easy to click.

exit.note: the palace doorway gap, shared by every courtyard scene; leads on toward the throne room
